summary: This joint resolution designates August 26th as a National Day of Remembrance to honor the American servicemembers killed in the 2021 bombing at Abbey Gate in Kabul, Afghanistan, and expresses condolences and gratitude to their families.

scores.thoughts: This joint resolution honors servicemembers who died during the Afghanistan withdrawal. While it pertains to military personnel and their sacrifice, it does not propose any changes to military spending or defense policy. Its focus is commemorative.
